1: # Implementation Tasks: Define Launch Strategy
2: 
3: ## Overview
4: This change is primarily a **planning and documentation** change. Implementation tasks focus on service setup, configuration, and documentation rather than code changes. Most tasks can be completed by following platform documentation and require minimal custom code.
5: 
6: ## Phase 1: Domain and DNS Setup
7: 
8: ### Task 1.1: Register domain name
9: - [x] Register `cocobu.online` via Cloudflare Registrar or Namecheap
10: - [ ] Enable auto-renewal to prevent expiration
11: - [ ] Document domain registration details in team password manager
12: 
13: **Validation**: Domain is registered and shows in registrar dashboard
14: 
15: **Estimated time**: 20 minutes
16: 
17: ### Task 1.2: Configure Cloudflare DNS
18: - [ ] Add domain to Cloudflare account
19: - [ ] Update nameservers at registrar to point to Cloudflare
20: - [ ] Wait for DNS propagation (up to 24-48 hours)
21: - [ ] Verify nameservers are updated using `dig NS cocobu.online`
22: 
23: **Validation**: `dig cocobu.online` resolves using Cloudflare nameservers
24: 
25: **Estimated time**: 15 minutes (plus propagation wait time)
26: 
27: ### Task 1.3: Create DNS records for services
28: - [ ] Create A/CNAME record: `cocobu.online` → Vercel (will be configured in Task 2.2)
29: - [ ] Create A/CNAME record: `api.cocobu.online` → Railway (will be configured in Task 3.2)
30: - [ ] Create CNAME record: `www.cocobu.online` → `cocobu.online`
31: - [ ] Enable Cloudflare proxy (orange cloud) for DDoS protection
32: 
33: **Validation**: All DNS records resolve correctly using `dig` command
34: 
35: **Estimated time**: 20 minutes
36: 
37: ### Task 1.4: Configure DNSSEC and CAA records
38: - [ ] Enable DNSSEC in Cloudflare dashboard
39: - [ ] Copy DS records from Cloudflare
40: - [ ] Add DS records to domain registrar
41: - [ ] Create CAA record: `0 issue "letsencrypt.org"`
42: - [ ] Create CAA record: `0 iodef "mailto:[EMAIL_REDACTED]"`
43: - [ ] Verify DNSSEC with `dig +dnssec cocobu.online`
44: 
45: **Validation**: DNSSEC is active, CAA records are configured
46: 
47: **Estimated time**: 30 minutes
48: 
49: ### Task 1.5: Configure email DNS records
50: - [ ] Sign up for Resend email service
51: - [ ] Add domain to Resend
52: - [ ] Create SPF record as specified by Resend: `v=spf1 include:_spf.resend.com ~all`
53: - [ ] Create DKIM CNAME records as specified by Resend
54: - [ ] Create DMARC record: `v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:[EMAIL_REDACTED]`
55: - [ ] Send test email and verify SPF/DKIM/DMARC pass
56: 
57: **Validation**: Test email passes all authentication checks and delivers to inbox
58: 
59: **Estimated time**: 45 minutes
60: 
61: ## Phase 2: Frontend Deployment (Vercel)
62: 
63: ### Task 2.1: Create Vercel project
64: - [ ] Sign up for Vercel account (if not exists)
65: - [ ] Install Vercel CLI: `npm install -g vercel`
66: - [ ] Link repository to Vercel: `vercel link`
67: - [ ] Configure build settings (Next.js detected automatically)
68: - [ ] Set root directory to `apps/web`
69: 
70: **Validation**: Vercel project is created and linked to GitHub repo
71: 
72: **Estimated time**: 15 minutes
73: 
74: ### Task 2.2: Configure production environment
75: - [ ] Add custom domain in Vercel dashboard: `cocobu.online`
76: - [ ] Add custom domain: `www.cocobu.online` (redirect to apex)
77: - [ ] Verify DNS records are correct
78: - [ ] Wait for SSL certificate provisioning (automatic)
79: - [ ] Set environment variables in Vercel dashboard:
80:   - `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.cocobu.online`
81:   - Any other public environment variables
82: - [ ] Deploy to production
83: 
84: **Validation**: `https://cocobu.online` loads successfully with SSL
85: 
86: **Estimated time**: 30 minutes
87: 
88: ### Task 2.3: Configure preview deployments
89: - [ ] Enable preview deployments for all pull requests
90: - [ ] Configure preview environment variables with read-only or mock API endpoints
91: - [ ] Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_PREVIEW_MODE=true` to activate demo data mode
92: - [ ] Ensure preview deployments cannot perform write operations to production
93: - [ ] Test preview deployment by creating sample PR
94: - [ ] Verify Vercel bot comments on PR with preview URL
95: - [ ] Verify preview uses mock data or read-only access
96: 
97: **Validation**: Preview deployment is created for PR and cannot modify production data
98: 
99: **Estimated time**: 20 minutes
100: 
101: ## Phase 3: Backend Deployment (Railway)
102: 
103: ### Task 3.1: Create Railway project
104: - [ ] Sign up for Railway account (if not exists)
105: - [ ] Install Railway CLI: `npm install -g @railway/cli`
106: - [ ] Create new project: `railway init`
107: - [ ] Link GitHub repository
108: - [ ] Select `apps/api` as root directory
109: 
110: **Validation**: Railway project is created and linked
111: 
112: **Estimated time**: 15 minutes
113: 
114: ### Task 3.2: Configure MySQL database
115: - [ ] Add MySQL plugin in Railway dashboard
116: - [ ] Wait for database provisioning
117: - [ ] Copy `DATABASE_URL` from Railway environment
118: - [ ] Run Prisma migrations: `railway run npm run db:migrate:deploy`
119: - [ ] Verify database connection
120: 
121: **Validation**: Database is created and migrations are applied
122: 
123: **Estimated time**: 20 minutes
124: 
125: ### Task 3.3: Configure backend environment variables
126: - [ ] Set environment variables in Railway:
127:   - `DATABASE_URL` (auto-generated by MySQL plugin)
128:   - `DATABASE_CONNECTION_LIMIT=5` (Railway free tier limit)
129:   - `DATABASE_POOL_TIMEOUT=10000` (10s connection timeout)
130:   - `DATABASE_QUERY_TIMEOUT=5000` (5s query timeout)
131:   - `JWT_SECRET` (generate secure random string)
132:   - `JWT_EXPIRES_IN=7d`
133:   - `MAGIC_LINK_SECRET` (generate secure random string)
134:   - `MAGIC_LINK_EXPIRES_IN=15m`
135:   - `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD` (from Resend)
136:   - `FRONTEND_URL=https://cocobu.online`
137:   - `NODE_ENV=production`
138: - [ ] Configure Prisma connection pool settings in code to use env vars
139: - [ ] Verify all required variables are set
140: 
141: **Validation**: All environment variables are configured including connection pool limits
142: 
143: **Estimated time**: 25 minutes
144: 
145: ### Task 3.4: Configure custom domain
146: - [ ] Add custom domain in Railway: `api.cocobu.online`
147: - [ ] Update DNS CNAME record to Railway target
148: - [ ] Wait for SSL certificate provisioning
149: - [ ] Verify health check endpoint: `https://api.cocobu.online/health`
150: 
151: **Validation**: API is accessible at custom domain with SSL
152: 
153: **Estimated time**: 15 minutes
154: 
155: ### Task 3.5: Configure automatic deployments
156: - [ ] Enable GitHub integration in Railway
157: - [ ] Configure auto-deploy from `main` branch to production
158: - [ ] Enable build notifications (optional)
159: - [ ] Test deployment by pushing to main branch
160: 
161: **Validation**: Push to main triggers automatic deployment
162: 
163: **Estimated time**: 15 minutes
164: 
165: ## Phase 4: Storage Setup (Cloudflare R2)
166: 
167: ### Task 4.1: Create R2 bucket
168: - [ ] Sign up for Cloudflare account (if not already done for DNS)
169: - [ ] Navigate to R2 storage
170: - [ ] Create bucket: `cocobu-production-files`
171: - [ ] Enable versioning in bucket settings
172: - [ ] Configure lifecycle rule: delete versions older than 30 days
173: 
174: **Validation**: Bucket is created with versioning enabled
175: 
176: **Estimated time**: 15 minutes
177: 
178: ### Task 4.2: Create API credentials
179: - [ ] Generate R2 API token in Cloudflare dashboard
180: - [ ] Copy Access Key ID and Secret Access Key
181: - [ ] Add credentials to Railway environment:
182:   - `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`
183:   - `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`
184:   - `R2_ENDPOINT` (from bucket settings)
185:   - `R2_BUCKET_NAME=cocobu-production-files`
186:   - `R2_PUBLIC_URL` (optional, for CDN)
187: 
188: **Validation**: Credentials are configured and accessible to backend
189: 
190: **Estimated time**: 10 minutes
191: 
192: ### Task 4.3: Configure CDN for R2 (optional)
193: - [ ] Create custom domain for R2 bucket (e.g., `files.cocobu.online`)
194: - [ ] Add CNAME DNS record pointing to R2 bucket URL
195: - [ ] Configure cache rules in Cloudflare
196: - [ ] Test file upload and retrieval via CDN URL
197: 
198: **Validation**: Files are accessible via CDN URL with caching
199: 
200: **Estimated time**: 20 minutes (optional)
201: 
202: ## Phase 5: Monitoring Setup
203: 
204: ### Task 5.1: Configure Sentry error tracking
205: - [ ] Sign up for Sentry account
206: - [ ] Create project for frontend (Next.js)
207: - [ ] Create project for backend (NestJS)
208: - [ ] Install Sentry SDK in frontend: `npm install @sentry/nextjs`
209: - [ ] Install Sentry SDK in backend: `npm install @sentry/nestjs`
210: - [ ] Configure Sentry in frontend (`sentry.client.config.ts`)
211: - [ ] Configure Sentry in backend (Sentry module)
212: - [ ] Add `SENTRY_DSN` to environment variables (Vercel and Railway)
213: - [ ] Test error capture by triggering test error
214: 
215: **Validation**: Test errors appear in Sentry dashboard
216: 
217: **Estimated time**: 60 minutes
218: 
219: ### Task 5.2: Configure performance monitoring
220: - [ ] Enable performance monitoring in Sentry projects
221: - [ ] Configure sample rate: 10% for normal traffic, 100% for slow transactions
222: - [ ] Set up custom transactions for key operations (API endpoints, database queries)
223: - [ ] Test performance trace capture
224: - [ ] Review performance data in Sentry dashboard
225: 
226: **Validation**: Performance traces appear in Sentry
227: 
228: **Estimated time**: 30 minutes
229: 
230: ### Task 5.3: Configure alert rules in Sentry
231: - [ ] Create alert rule: Error rate > 5% for 5 minutes
232: - [ ] Create alert rule: Specific error types (database connection, authentication failures)
233: - [ ] Create alert rule: Connection pool exhaustion errors (Prisma P2024, P1001)
234: - [ ] Create alert rule: Connection pool utilization > 80% for 5 minutes
235: - [ ] Configure notification channel: Email
236: - [ ] Configure alert frequency: Once per 15 minutes per rule
237: - [ ] Test alerts by triggering error condition
238: 
239: **Validation**: Alerts are sent to configured email including connection pool warnings
240: 
241: **Estimated time**: 40 minutes
242: 
243: ### Task 5.4: Set up uptime monitoring (UptimeRobot)
244: - [ ] Sign up for UptimeRobot free account
245: - [ ] Create monitor for frontend: `https://cocobu.online`
246: - [ ] Create monitor for backend health: `https://api.cocobu.online/health`
247: - [ ] Configure check interval: 5 minutes
248: - [ ] Configure alert contacts: Email
249: - [ ] Configure alert threshold: 2 consecutive failures
